description: Small English evaluation corpus. Synthetic clips are ground truth by construction (Windows SAPI TTS: the spoken text is known exactly); noisy clips are the same speech mixed with white noise; the real-speech clip stays unscored until a human verifies its reference. Audio is generated by scripts/make_eval_corpus.py and never committed.
